description: Told the user no ReMarkable skill existed after searching only the plugin skills path. Failed to check the IES-local skill directory at .claude/skills/. The remarkable-upload skill exists at .claude/skills/remarkable-upload/SKILL.md and was never found because the search was too narrow.
correction: Always search both the plugin skills path AND the IES .claude/skills/ directory before declaring a skill unavailable. The find command should have targeted the IES tree.
systemic_fix: Add .claude/skills/ to the standard skill-lookup search path. Never tell the user a capability doesn't exist without checking both locations.
